name: AirScout
description: Current US AQI and pollutants for any point on Earth, whether it is safe to exercise outdoors (EPA AirNow categories), and the cleanest and worst windows in the next 7 days. Plain GET with free previews; USDC 0.01 per query over x402 on Base, Arbitrum or Polygon, or XRP/RLUSD on the XRP Ledger. A2A 0.3.0 JSON-RPC at https://airscout.scalpstream.com/a2a, OpenAPI at https://airscout.scalpstream.com/openapi.json. Modelled data (Copernicus CAMS via Open-Meteo), not medical advice.
